newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya's Moi returns from Zaire meeting.
newsitem.headline: Kenya's Moi returns from Zaire meeting.

text.p: Kenyan President Daniel arap Moi returned home late on Monday after a day's visit to Zaire where he held talks with President Mobutu Sese Seko on the crisis in the Great Lakes region.
Moi made no remarks on arrival at the Nairobi international airport but officials described the talks with Mobutu as fruitful.

The meeting held at Mobutu's jungle palace at Gbadolite was a follow-up to last December's Nairobi summit of 10 African leaders, boycotted by Kinshasa, which discussed the deteriorating situation in central Africa after ethnic Tutsi rebels seized control of eastern Zaire.
